service_account_json.label: Service account auth JSON
service_account_json.description: Service account auth JSON. Looks like {"id": "...", "service_account_id": "...", "private_key": "..."}. Will be used instead of OAuth token and SA JSON file path field if specified.

service_account_json_path.label: Service account auth JSON file path
service_account_json_path.description: Service account auth JSON file path. File content looks like {"id": "...", "service_account_id": "...", "private_key": "..."}. Will be used instead of OAuth token if specified.

oauth.label: OAuth Token
oauth.description: User account OAuth token. Either this or service account JSON must be specified.

folder_id.label: Default folder ID
folder_id.description: Optional. If specified, this ID will be used by default when creating nodes and clusters.

public_ssh_key.label: Public SSH key
public_ssh_key.description: Optional. The key will be placed to all created Compute nodes, allowing you to have a root shell there.

endpoint.label: API endpoint
endpoint.description: Optional. Specify an API endpoint. Leave blank to use default.
